views.def:
SELECT c.id,
    c.name,
    c.active,
    c.description,
    c.employee_count_range,
    c.founded_on,
    c.industries,
    c.linkedin_url,
    c.locations,
    c.logo,
    c.phone,
    c.specialities,
    c.tagline,
    c.universal_name,
    c.website,
    c.created_at,
    c.employees,
    c.last_scraped_at,
    c.owner_uuid,
    c.employees_count,
    COALESCE(op.open_positions_count, 0) AS open_positions_count,
    (c.employees_count + COALESCE(op.open_positions_count, 0)) AS activity_score,
    op.latest_job_at
   FROM (companies c
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT open_position.company_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS open_positions_count,
            max(open_position.created_at) AS latest_job_at
           FROM open_position
          WHERE (open_position.job_description_html IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY open_position.company_id) op ON ((op.company_id = c.id)));
views.name: companies_ranked

views.def:
SELECT uuid,
    role,
    created_at,
    status,
    is_anonymous,
    privacy_lastname,
    privacy_picture,
    privacy_contact_details,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE name
        END AS name,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE first_name
        END AS first_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE about
        END AS about,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text[]
            ELSE interests
        END AS interests,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::jsonb
            ELSE languages
        END AS languages,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text[]
            ELSE work_preferences
        END AS work_preferences,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::jsonb
            ELSE experience
        END AS experience,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::jsonb
            ELSE education
        END AS education,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::jsonb
            ELSE certifications
        END AS certifications,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text[]
            ELSE skills
        END AS skills,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE location
        END AS location,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE cover_image_url
        END AS cover_image_url,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE headline
        END AS headline,
        CASE
            WHEN has_privacy_access(uuid, privacy_contact_details, is_anonymous) THEN email
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS email,
        CASE
            WHEN has_privacy_access(uuid, privacy_contact_details, is_anonymous) THEN phone
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS phone,
        CASE
            WHEN has_privacy_access(uuid, privacy_lastname, is_anonymous) THEN last_name
            WHEN ((privacy_lastname IS NULL) AND (NOT is_anonymous)) THEN last_name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS last_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (has_privacy_access(uuid, privacy_picture, is_anonymous) AND (image IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'true'::text
            WHEN ((privacy_picture IS NULL) AND (NOT is_anonymous) AND (image IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'true'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS image,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::jsonb
            ELSE projects
        END AS projects,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE github_url
        END AS github_url,
        CASE
            WHEN (is_anonymous AND (uuid <> auth.uid())) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE website_url
        END AS website_url
   FROM users;
views.name: public_users_view

views.def:
SELECT puv.uuid,
    puv.role,
    puv.created_at,
    puv.status,
    puv.is_anonymous,
    puv.privacy_lastname,
    puv.privacy_picture,
    puv.privacy_contact_details,
    puv.name,
    puv.first_name,
    puv.about,
    puv.interests,
    puv.languages,
    puv.work_preferences,
    puv.experience,
    puv.education,
    puv.certifications,
    puv.skills,
    puv.location,
    puv.cover_image_url,
    puv.headline,
    puv.email,
    puv.phone,
    puv.last_name,
    puv.image,
    u.job_seeking_status,
    u.last_name AS raw_last_name,
    u.email AS raw_email,
    u.phone AS raw_phone,
    u.privacy_lastname AS user_privacy_lastname,
    u.privacy_picture AS user_privacy_picture,
    ((u.image IS NOT NULL) AND (u.image <> ''::text)) AS has_image,
    calculate_experience_years(puv.experience) AS experience_years
   FROM (public_users_view puv
     JOIN users u ON ((u.uuid = puv.uuid)));
views.name: talent_search_view

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.archive_deleted_comment()

 SET search_path TO 'public'

  INSERT INTO public.deleted_comments (
    id,
    post_id,
    sender,
    message,

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_invite_before_user_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.invites
    WHERE LOWER(recipient_email) = LOWER(NEW.email)
      AND status = 'pending'
      AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'insert_without_invite: No valid pending invite for email: %', NEW.email
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: check_invite_before_user_insert

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.correct_role_from_invite()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  invite_role TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT i.role INTO invite_role
  FROM public.invites i
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(i.recipient_email)) = LOWER(TRIM(NEW.email))
    AND i.status = 'pending'
    AND (i.expires_at IS NULL OR i.expires_at > NOW())
  ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF invite_role IS NOT NULL AND invite_role != 'community' THEN
    NEW.role := invite_role;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: correct_role_from_invite

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.extract_mention_ids(p_text text, p_html_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(m[1])::uuid FROM (
    SELECT regexp_matches(coalesce(p_text, ''),
      'data-user-id="([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12})"', 'g') AS m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT regexp_matches(coalesce(p_text, ''),
      '@\[[^\]]+\]\(([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12})\)', 'g')
    WHERE NOT p_html_only
  ) s;
$function$
functions.name: extract_mention_ids

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feed_cache_on_comment_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE feed_cache
  SET effective_date = COALESCE(
    (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM comments WHERE post_id = OLD.post_id),
    sent_at
  )
  WHERE post_id = OLD.post_id;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
functions.name: feed_cache_on_comment_delete

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feed_cache_on_comment_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE feed_cache
  SET effective_date = GREATEST(effective_date, NEW.created_at)
  WHERE post_id = NEW.post_id;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
functions.name: feed_cache_on_comment_insert

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feed_cache_on_post_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.post_type IS NOT NULL AND NEW.post_type != 'email' AND NEW.sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO feed_cache(post_id, effective_date, sender, post_type, community_members_only, sent_at)
    VALUES (
      NEW.id,
      NEW.sent_at,
      NEW.sender,
      NEW.post_type,
      COALESCE(NEW.community_members_only, false),
      NEW.sent_at
    )
    ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_post_impressions_chart(p_sender_email text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(impression_date date, daily_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT pi.impression_date, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS daily_count
  FROM post_impressions pi
  JOIN posts p ON p.id::TEXT = pi.post_id
  WHERE LOWER(p.sender) = LOWER(p_sender_email)
    AND pi.impression_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
  GROUP BY pi.impression_date
  ORDER BY pi.impression_date;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_stabilized_feed(p_session_start timestamp with time zone, p_last_effective_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_last_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 25, p_filter_email text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, sender text, subject text, message text, attachments jsonb, sent_at timestamp with time zone, post_type text, community_members_only boolean, effective_sort_date timestamp with time zone, is_saved boolean, company_id bigint, posted_by_uuid uuid, linked_article_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT
    p.id::text,
    p.sender::text,
    p.subject::text,
    p.message::text,
    p.attachments::jsonb,
    p.sent_at::timestamptz,
    p.post_type::text,
    COALESCE(p.community_members_only, false)::boolean,
    fc.effective_date::timestamptz AS effective_sort_date,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM saved_resources sr
      WHERE sr.saved_resource_id  = p.id::text
        AND sr.user_id            = auth.uid()
        AND sr.saved_resource_type = 'post'
    )::boolean AS is_saved,
    p.company_id,
    p.posted_by_uuid,
    p.linked_article_id::text
  FROM feed_cache fc
  JOIN posts p ON p.id = fc.post_id
  WHERE
    (p_filter_email IS NULL OR fc.sender = p_filter_email)
    AND (
      p_last_effective_date IS NULL
      OR fc.effective_date < p_last_effective_date
      OR (fc.effective_date = p_last_effective_date AND fc.post_id < p_last_id)
    )
  ORDER BY fc.effective_date DESC, fc.post_id DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
$function$
functions.args: p_session_start timestamp with time zone, p_last_effective_date timestamp with time zone, p_last_id text, p_limit integer, p_filter_email text
functions.name: get_stabilized_feed

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_cancel_connection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- אם הסטטוס היה pending (כלומר עדיין לא אושר), נמחק את ההתראה
    IF OLD.status = 'pending' THEN
        DELETE FROM notifications 
        WHERE user_id = OLD.receiver_id 
          AND actor_id = OLD.requester_id 
          AND type = 'CONN_REQ';
    END IF;
    
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$
functions.name: handle_cancel_connection

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_connection_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- מקרה 1: בקשה חדשה נוצרת (INSERT)
    -- המשתמש המקבל (receiver) מקבל התראה שמישהו (requester) רוצה להתחבר
    IF (TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND NEW.status = 'pending') THEN
        INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, target_id, type, count)
        VALUES (NEW.receiver_id, NEW.requester_id, NEW.requester_id, 'CONN_REQ', 1);
    
    -- מקרה 2: סטטוס משתנה למאושר (UPDATE)
    -- המשתמש ששלח את הבקשה (requester) מקבל התראה שאישרו אותו
    ELSIF (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status = 'pending' AND NEW.status = 'accepted') THEN
        INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, target_id, type, count)
        VALUES (NEW.requester_id, NEW.receiver_id, NEW.receiver_id, 'CONN_ACCEPT', 1);
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: handle_connection_change

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := coalesce(auth.uid(), NEW.author_uuid);
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, target_id, type, count, is_read)
    SELECT f.follower_uuid, v_actor, NEW.id::text, 'NEW_ARTICLE', 1, false
    FROM article_author_follows f
    WHERE NEW.author_uuid IS NOT NULL AND f.author_uuid = NEW.author_uuid
      AND f.follower_uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor;

    -- company followers who don't already follow the author
    INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, target_id, type, count, is_read)
    SELECT f.follower_uuid, v_actor, NEW.id::text, 'NEW_COMPANY_ARTICLE', 1, false
    FROM article_company_follows f
    WHERE NEW.company_id IS NOT NULL AND f.company_id = NEW.company_id
      AND f.follower_uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_author_follows af
                      WHERE af.author_uuid = NEW.author_uuid AND af.follower_uuid = f.follower_uuid);
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE WARNING 'notify_article_published: %', SQLERRM;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.people_search_companies(p_viewer_id uuid, p_scope text DEFAULT 'connections'::text, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(company_key text, name text, company_id bigint, logo text, current_count bigint, past_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_mine   UUID[];
  v_within UUID[];
  v_except UUID[];
  v_q      TEXT := people_search_normalize(p_query);
  v_q_key  TEXT := people_search_company_key(p_query);
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() <> p_viewer_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'people_search_companies: viewer mismatch';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(other_id), '{}') INTO v_mine
  FROM get_accepted_connection_ids(p_viewer_id);
  IF p_scope = 'connections' THEN v_within := v_mine; ELSE v_except := v_mine; END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH entries AS (
    SELECT i.user_uuid, x->>'key' AS key, x->>'name' AS name,
           NULLIF(x->>'id', '')::BIGINT AS cid, TRUE AS is_current
    FROM people_search_index i, jsonb_array_elements(i.current_companies) x
    WHERE (v_within IS NULL OR i.user_uuid = ANY (v_within))
      AND (v_except IS NULL OR i.user_uuid <> ALL (v_except))
      AND i.user_uuid <> p_viewer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.user_uuid, x->>'key', x->>'name', NULLIF(x->>'id', '')::BIGINT, FALSE
    FROM people_search_index i, jsonb_array_elements(i.past_companies) x
    WHERE (v_within IS NULL OR i.user_uuid = ANY (v_within))
      AND (v_except IS NULL OR i.user_uuid <> ALL (v_except))
      AND i.user_uuid <> p_viewer_id
  ),
  per_member AS (
    -- someone who worked there before and works there now counts once, as current
    SELECT key, user_uuid, bool_or(is_current) AS is_current
    FROM entries
    GROUP BY key, user_uuid
  ),
  agg AS (
    SELECT
      e.key,
      mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.name) AS name,   -- most common spelling
      max(e.cid) AS cid
    FROM entries e
    GROUP BY e.key
  )
  SELECT
    a.key,
    COALESCE(a.name, co.name),   -- canonical spelling ("Ness", not "Ness Technologies | נס טכנולוגיות")
    a.cid,
    co.logo::TEXT,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pm.is_current),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT pm.is_current)
  FROM agg a
  JOIN per_member pm ON pm.key = a.key
  LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = a.cid
  WHERE v_q = ''
     OR strpos(people_search_normalize(COALESCE(a.name, '')), v_q) > 0
     OR strpos(people_search_normalize(COALESCE(co.name, '')), v_q) > 0
     OR (v_q_key <> '' AND strpos(a.key, v_q_key) > 0)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_aliases ca
                WHERE ca.canonical_key = a.key
                  AND strpos(people_search_normalize(ca.alias), v_q) > 0)
  GROUP BY a.key, co.name, a.name, a.cid, co.logo
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pm.is_current) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, COALESCE(a.name, co.name)
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$
functions.args: p_viewer_id uuid, p_scope text, p_query text, p_limit integer
functions.name: people_search_companies

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.people_search_company_key(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(p, ''))),
          '\.(com|co\.il|org\.il|io|ai|net|org|co)\M', '', 'g'),
        '\m(inc|ltd|llc|co|corp|gmbh|bv|sa|plc|israel)\M', '', 'g'),
      '(בע"מ|בע״מ|בעמ|\sישראל)\s*$', '', 'g'),
    '[^a-z0-9א-ת]', '', 'g');
$function$
functions.name: people_search_company_key

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_user_role()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$begin
  -- עדכון טבלת המשתמשים של Supabase Auth
  update auth.users
  set raw_app_meta_data = 
    -- אנחנו משתמשים ב-jsonb_set כדי לא לדרוס מידע אחר אם קיים, אלא רק לעדכן את המפתח 'role'
    jsonb_set(
      coalesce(raw_app_meta_data, '{}'::jsonb), 
      '{role}', 
      to_jsonb(new.role)
    )
  where id = new.uuid; -- ההנחה היא שה-ID בטבלה שלך זהה ל-UUID של המשתמש ב-Auth
  
  return new;
end;$function$
functions.name: sync_user_role

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_user_to_company()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- 1. ניקוי: הסרת המשתמש מכל החברות שבהן הוא מופיע כרגע
  -- אנחנו עושים את זה קודם כדי להתחיל דף חלק לפני העדכון הנוכחי
  UPDATE public.companies 
  SET employees = array_remove(COALESCE(employees, '{}'::uuid[]), NEW.uuid::uuid)
  WHERE NEW.uuid::uuid = ANY(employees);

  -- 2. עדכון קבוצתי: הוספת המשתמש לכל החברות שמוגדרות כ-current
  UPDATE public.companies 
  SET employees = array_append(COALESCE(employees, '{}'::uuid[]), NEW.uuid::uuid)
  WHERE id IN (
    SELECT 
      CASE 
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(elem->'company') = 'object' THEN (elem->'company'->>'id')::int
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(elem->'company') = 'number' THEN (elem->>'company')::int
        -- אם זה טקסט (כמו Ness), ננסה למצוא לפי שם אם אין ID
        ELSE NULL 
      END
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NEW.experience, '[]'::jsonb)) AS elem
    WHERE (elem->>'current')::boolean IS TRUE
  )
  -- בונוס: אם בחברה השלישית כתוב "Ness" (טקסט), ננסה לתפוס אותה לפי שם
  OR lower(trim(name)) IN (
    SELECT lower(trim(elem->>'company'))
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NEW.experience, '[]'::jsonb)) AS elem
    WHERE (elem->>'current')::boolean IS TRUE 
    AND jsonb_typeof(elem->'company') = 'string'
  );

  -- 3. לוג לביקורת
  INSERT INTO public.trigger_logs (user_uuid, event_name, data_seen)
  VALUES (NEW.uuid, 'Multi-Sync Executed', 'Synced all current companies from JSON');

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: sync_user_to_company

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_user_activity_on_connection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'accepted' AND (OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'accepted') THEN
    INSERT INTO user_activity (
      user_id, total_connections, first_connection_at, last_active_at, updated_at
    )
    VALUES (NEW.requester_id, 1, now(), now(), now())
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
      total_connections   = user_activity.total_connections + 1,
      first_connection_at = COALESCE(user_activity.first_connection_at, now()),
      last_active_at      = now(),
      updated_at          = now();

    INSERT INTO user_activity (
      user_id, total_connections, first_connection_at, last_active_at, updated_at
    )
    VALUES (NEW.receiver_id, 1, now(), now(), now())
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
      total_connections   = user_activity.total_connections + 1,
      first_connection_at = COALESCE(user_activity.first_connection_at, now()),
      last_active_at      = now(),
      updated_at          = now();
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: trg_user_activity_on_connection

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_user_activity_on_post()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO user_activity (
    user_id, total_posts, last_post_at, first_post_at, last_active_at, updated_at
  )
  VALUES (NEW.posted_by_uuid, 1, now(), now(), now(), now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
    total_posts    = user_activity.total_posts + 1,
    last_post_at   = now(),
    first_post_at  = COALESCE(user_activity.first_post_at, now()),
    last_active_at = now(),
    updated_at     = now();
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
